title: I need to go
goal: Say who needs or wants something done, with -mAk and the possessive endings.

intro.text: `-mAk` takes the possessive endings: *gitmegim* (my going). Before *gerek* that says who needs to: *Meniň gitmegim gerek* (I need to go). With *islemek* you can want someone else to act: *Men onuň gelmegini isleýärin* (I want him to come).

exercises.label: *gitmek* with the possessive endings: my going, your going…
exercises.explain: *git-* + *-mek*; before the vowel of the ending, k → g: *gitmegim*. For **they**, *-leri* keeps the k: *gitmekleri*.

exercises.question: How do you say **I need to rest**?

why.1: *-yň* is **your**: *dynç almagyň gerek* is **you need to rest**.
why.2: The person goes in the genitive: *Meniň dynç almagym gerek*.

exercises.explain: *almak* + *-ym* (my), with k → g: *Meniň dynç almagym gerek*.

exercises.en: You need to study a lot.

reject.why: With *seniň* in front, the verbal noun needs **your**: *okamagyň*.

exercises.explain: *okamak* + *-yň* (your), with k → g: *Seniň köp okamagyň gerek*.

accept: It is important that you come tomorrow.
It is important for you to come tomorrow.
It is important that you come here tomorrow.

reject.why: With *meniň*, the verbal noun needs **my**: *Meniň gitmegim gerek*.
`-mAlY` has no personal ending, so keep the subject: *Men gitmeli*.

exercises.explain: *gitmek* + *-im*, with k → g: *Meniň gitmegim gerek*. *Men gitmeli* says the same.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **I want you to come**?

why.1: This one is **I want to come**.
why.3: This one is **you want to come**.

exercises.explain: Someone else's action takes their possessive and the accusative: *seniň gelmegiňi*.

exercises.label: *gelmek* + possessive + accusative: (Mum wants) me to come, you to come…
exercises.explain: *gelmeg-* + the possessive + *-i*; after **his**, **her**, **their**, an *n* comes first: *gelmegini*.

accept: My mother wants me to become a doctor.
My mum wants me to become a doctor.
My mother wants me to be a doctor.
My mum wants me to be a doctor.
[Mum|My mom|Mom] wants me to [be|become] a doctor.

exercises.prompt: We are waiting for Dad to come.

exercises.en: The teacher wants us to read a lot.
exercises.explain: Our reading, as the object of *isleýär*: *okamagymyzy*.

accept: My dream is to speak Turkmen well.
My dream is speaking Turkmen well.
It is my dream to speak Turkmen well.

exercises.prompt: My aim is to learn Turkmen.

reject.why: Here the action just names the aim, so `-mAk` stays bare: *öwrenmek*.

exercises.explain: *maksat* voices its t: *maksadym*. The aim itself is the bare `-mAk`: *öwrenmek*.

exercises.gloss: my studying (I need to study: … gerek)
exercises.explain: *oka-* + *-mak* + *-ym* (my): the k becomes g before the vowel.
